data:
Usage: mcpjam cloud eval iterations [options]

List per-iteration results for an eval run (pass/fail, tool calls, tokens,
latency)

Options:
  --run <id>              Eval run ID (from `eval run`)
  --project <id-or-name>  Project name or ID (defaults to the most recently
                          updated project)
  --cursor <cursor>       Pagination cursor from a previous response
  --limit <n>             Max iterations per page (1–200)
  -h, --help              display help for command

schemaVersion: "2"
mode: agentWorkflow
reportingMode: standard
suite:
  id: s_arithmetic_smoke
  name: Arithmetic smoke
target:
  servers:
    - name: Arithmetic
defaults:
  judge:
    enabled: false
  model: anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5
  iterations: 1
  passThreshold: 1
  validity: {}
cases:
  - id: c_add_two_three
    title: Add 2 and 3 and return 5
    steps:
      - id: ask
        kind: toolCall
        toolName: add
        serverName: Arithmetic
        arguments: {a: 2, b: 3}
      - id: args
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: toolCalledWith
          toolName: add
          args:
            args: {a: 2, b: 3}
            argumentMatching: exact
      - id: result
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: toolResultContains
          toolName: add
          needle: '5'
      - id: errors
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: noToolErrors
